recipe.title: Pan Con Tomate Breakfast

steps.text: Toast the bread until crisp.
Grate tomatoes and season with olive oil and salt.
Spoon tomato over toast and serve with oranges.

substitutions: Use wholegrain bread for more fiber.
Add avocado when available.
allergen_notes: Contains gluten.

meals.planning_reason: quick Mediterranean breakfast; serve Aria toast strips with grated tomato

recipe.title: Gazpacho With Chickpea Toast

steps.text: Blend tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, olive oil, vinegar, and salt.
Toast bread and crush chickpeas with lemon and oil.
Serve chilled gazpacho with chickpea toast.

substitutions: Use white beans instead of chickpeas.
Skip bread for a lighter lunch.
allergen_notes: Bread contains gluten.

meals.planning_reason: fresh light lunch; keep soup less salty for Aria

recipe.title: Mediterranean Chicken Rice

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Dice the onion, pepper, and tomatoes. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the chicken with a little oil, then add onion and pepper until softened.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add rice, tomato, salt, and water. Simmer covered until the rice is tender.

substitutions: Use turkey breast instead of chicken.
Use frozen vegetable mix if fresh peppers are unavailable.
allergen_notes: No common allergens when cooked without stock cubes containing gluten.

meals.planning_reason: balanced family dinner and good leftover base

recipe.title: Yogurt Oat Breakfast Bowl

steps.text: Divide yogurt between bowls.
Top with oats, sliced banana, and berries.
Chill briefly or serve immediately.

substitutions: Use soy yogurt for a dairy-free bowl.
Use apple instead of berries.
allergen_notes: Contains dairy unless plant yogurt is used. Oats may contain gluten traces.

recipe.title: Tuna And White Bean Salad

steps.text: Drain tuna and beans.
Chop tomato, onion, and lettuce.
Toss everything with olive oil, vinegar, and salt.

substitutions: Use chickpeas instead of white beans.
Use canned salmon instead of tuna.
allergen_notes: Contains fish.

recipe.title: Lentil And Vegetable Stew

steps.title: Prep vegetables
steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots, and potatoes.

steps.title: Build base
steps.text: Saute onion, then add vegetables, lentils, stock, and water.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer until lentils and potatoes are tender. Adjust seasoning.

substitutions: Use chickpeas when lentils are unavailable.
Add spinach at the end for extra greens.
allergen_notes: Check stock cube labels for gluten or celery.

meals.planning_reason: batch-cook dinner; save extra portions for Wednesday lunch

recipe.title: Banana Oat Pancakes

steps.text: Blend bananas, oats, milk, and cinnamon into batter.
Cook small pancakes in a nonstick pan.
Serve with fruit or yogurt.

substitutions: Use plant milk for a dairy-free version.
Add berries to the batter.
allergen_notes: Contains dairy unless plant milk is used. Oats may contain gluten traces.

recipe.title: Cod With Spanish Pisto

steps.text: Dice vegetables and simmer with tomato sauce into pisto.
Boil or roast potatoes.
Cook cod gently on top of the pisto until flaky.

substitutions: Use hake instead of cod.
Serve with rice instead of potatoes.
allergen_notes: Contains fish.

recipe.title: Quinoa With Roasted Vegetables

steps.text: Roast diced sweet potato and broccoli.
Cook quinoa until fluffy.
Toss quinoa with vegetables, chickpeas, lemon, and olive oil.

substitutions: Use couscous if quinoa is unavailable.
Use carrots instead of sweet potato.
allergen_notes: No common allergens.

recipe.title: Vegetable Paella

steps.text: Saute vegetables in a wide pan.
Add rice, saffron or paprika, and hot stock.
Simmer without stirring until rice is tender.

substitutions: Use frozen vegetable paella mix.
Use regular short-grain rice if bomba rice is unavailable.
allergen_notes: Check stock labels for celery or gluten.

recipe.title: Arroz A La Cubana Inspired Bowl

steps.text: Cook rice until tender.
Warm tomato sauce and white beans.
Pan-sear banana halves and serve over rice with sauce.

substitutions: Use chickpeas instead of white beans.
Add a fried protein if desired.
allergen_notes: No common allergens.

recipe.title: Salmon With Potatoes And Green Beans

steps.title: Roast potatoes
steps.text: Cut potatoes and roast with oil and salt until nearly tender.

steps.title: Add salmon
steps.text: Place salmon on the tray with lemon and roast until cooked.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Boil or steam green beans and serve with the salmon and potatoes.

substitutions: Use hake or cod if salmon is unavailable.
allergen_notes: Contains fish.

meals.planning_reason: BBQ option: grill the salmon, potatoes, and green beans/veg with lemon and herbs

recipe.title: Falafel Wraps With Yogurt Sauce

steps.text: Warm falafel in a pan or oven.
Mix yogurt with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Fill wraps with lettuce, tomato, falafel, and sauce.

substitutions: Use hummus instead of yogurt sauce for a vegan wrap.
Serve over salad instead of wraps.
allergen_notes: Wraps contain gluten. Yogurt contains dairy.

meals.planning_reason: fresh lunch; deconstruct for Aria if needed

recipe.title: Spanish Tortilla With Salad

steps.title: Cook potatoes
steps.text: Slice potatoes and onion thinly. Cook gently in oil until tender.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Beat eggs, fold in potatoes and onion, and season.

steps.title: Set
steps.text: Cook in a nonstick pan until just set, flipping carefully with a plate.

substitutions: Serve with tomatoes if bagged salad is unavailable.
allergen_notes: Contains egg.

meals.planning_reason: simple shared family dinner with salad

recipe.title: Vegetable Pasta With Tomato Sauce

steps.title: Cook pasta
steps.text: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.

steps.title: Cook vegetables
steps.text: Saute sliced zucchini and mushrooms until browned.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Combine pasta, vegetables, and tomato sauce. Top with cheese if using.

substitutions: Skip cheese for a lighter or vegan version.
Use whole wheat pasta for more fiber.
allergen_notes: Contains gluten. Contains dairy when cheese is used.

recipe.title: Hake Rice Soup

steps.text: Simmer carrot and leek in stock.
Add rice and cook until nearly tender.
Add hake pieces and simmer gently until cooked.

substitutions: Use cod or salmon pieces.
Use vegetable stock if fish stock is unavailable.
allergen_notes: Contains fish.

meals.planning_reason: light fish dinner to finish the week

notes: Draft plan curated for Marcel, Mary, Lesli, and Aria: Mediterranean-leaning, healthy, tasty, child-shareable, with one BBQ fish option.
Treat Aria as a small portion: keep salt low, avoid whole nuts/choking hazards, cut grapes/tomatoes/firm foods small, and serve sauces/spices separately when needed.
Tuesday lentil stew is intentionally repeated for Wednesday lunch as batch cooking/leftovers.
Budget is a target only until product selection is run against the current Alcampo market; no basket/cart changes have been made.
